verdict.rationale: Wise's own site states the card lets you "Pay and withdraw cash worldwide without any hidden fees or markups." Its docs confirm debit card issuance and ATM spending permissions, so the core of the story is covered directly. missing for 10: a detailed fee schedule (ATM withdrawal allowances, conversion fees), explicit confirmation that the claim applies to Wise Business company cards, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-hidden-fee claim.

support.subject: As a founder, I can spend and withdraw cash abroad on a company card without hidden foreign fees
